headlines.text: Flash back to 2024, when it was title-change night for the AEW World Trios Titles as The Patriarchy vs. Gunns & Robinson battled it out, appearing on Collision, rated 6.56 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. For The Patriarchy and Gunns & Robinson, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. This stood as the 30th match in AEW World Trios Titles history ? a real landmark for that championship. Shayna Wayne's interference proved decisive as the newly-renamed Killswitch and Christian Cage crowned The Patriarchy new AEW World Trios Champions over the Bang Bang Gang.
